title: On End Turn (step 38) the combined trash zone shrank from 3 cards to 1 with no effect that banishes/returns cards from trash having been played (Goldfish opponent played nothing; P2 hand grew by exactly its draw, board unchanged). The 3 trash cards at step 37 were Keeper of Masks plus its two Reflection unit tokens, killed by Temporary at the start of turn 5; the two tokens sat in the trash zone f
expected: Rule 186.1 verified ("If a token is put into any Non-Board Zone besides the chain, it ceases to exist immediately"). The Beginning-phase Temporary kill in riftbound-flow.ts:327-368 does `context.zones.moveCard({cardId, targetZoneId: "trash"})` (line 364-367) for every Temporary permanent, tokens included, with no token-existence handling and no cleanup pass afterwards in the flow hook. The only implementation of 186.1 is sweepOffBoardTokens (cleanup/state-based-checks.ts:72-87), invoked solely as "Step 0" of performCleanup (line 251-254), which in turn only runs via post-move cleanup (withPostMoveCleanup -> cleanupAndFireDeaths -> runStateMaintenance) or chain/choice resolution. endTurn's reducer (moves/turn.ts:98-101) just calls flow.endPhase(); the post-move sweep runs before the next turn's Beginning-phase kill, so the tokens trashed there persist until the next move. Trace matches: step 36 base = Keeper of Masks + 2 Reflection tokens, trash 0; step 37 (turn 5 main) base = Noxian Emissary only, trash 3; step 38 (turn 7 main) trash 1, board unchanged, hands grew only by draws, goldfish played nothing — the 2 tokens sat in trash through turn 5 and were removed only when the End Turn move's cleanup pass ran.
rule: 186.1 (tokens cease to exist off-board) / Keeper of Masks Reflection tokens
